BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!

BOXER BRIEFS

The palace for your phallus

Our boxer briefs treat your crown jewels like royalty. We offer two designs to give you ultimate comfort and to eliminate sweat down under.

Pro - without Pouch
Your perfect daily wear without the fly. Larger front prevents any awkward re-adjustments.

Active - with Pouch
Athletic cut with our signature pouch. Keeps your banana and plums separate!

Like it more "Brief"?
Less is more with our latest brief design.
Find out more!


GOOD FOR YOUR BALLS, GOOD FOR THE PLANET

Made of wood, for your wood

Our very own textile MicroModal Air fibres are derived from sustainably grown, renewable European wood sources. These organic fibres last longer than cotton, are CO2-neutral and bio-degradable.


KEEPING YOU DRY & FLY

Don’t sweat it boys

MicroModal Air is 50% more absorbent and breathable than cotton, drying quicker and keeping you pleasantly cool all day long. Did we mention that these natural super fibres are anti-bacterial, helping to prevent body odour?




FITS LIKE A SECOND SKIN

Say bye to chafing

We made the inseam slightly longer to guarantee you a perfectly snug fit and no more riding up. Our stitching technique reduces skin irritation and we removed the commercial tag on the waistband as well. Bye annoying itching!


5X SOFTER THAN COTTON

Unbelievably soft

Can you imagine what something softer than silk feels like? Here's what our customer Paul said: “The material is so soft you basically don't know they are there.” We could not have said it better, Paul!
